crossRefs.note: They cried aloud, and cut themselves in their way with knives and lances, until the blood gushed out on them.
So Satan went out from the presence of Yahweh, and struck Job with painful sores from the sole of his foot to his head.
He took for himself a potsherd to scrape himself with, and he sat among the ashes.
You are of your father, the devil, and you want to do the desires of your father. He was a murderer from the beginning…

translations.web: Always, night and day, in the tombs and in the mountains, he was crying out, and cutting himself with stones.
translations.bsb: Night and day in the tombs and in the mountains he kept crying out and cutting himself with stones.
translations.kjv: And always, night and day, he was in the mountains, and in the tombs, crying, and cutting himself with stones.
translations.asv: And always, night and day, in the tombs and in the mountains, he was crying out, and cutting himself with stones.
